books: Has been in active journalism for around four decades Written/Edited several books: In Hindi:(i) Jharkhand: Samay aur Sawal, 2012, Prabhat Prakashan, (ii) Jharkhand: Sapne Aur Yatharth, 2012, Prabhat Prakashan, (iii)Shabd Sansar, 2016, India Telling Books, (iv) Dil se Maine Duniya Dekhi, 2018, Rajkamal Prakashan, (v) Ganesh Mantri: Aadhunik Hindi Patrkarita ke Yashasvee Stambh, 2022, Rudra Publishers, (vi) Kalash, 2022,Vaani Prakashan, (vii) Srishti ka Mukut: Kailas Mansarovar, 2022,Vaani Prakashan, (viii) Path ke Prakash Punj, 2022, Vaani Prakashan and(ix) Satyagrahi Sanyasi - Bhavani Dayal Sanyasi Ka Parichay, (E-book - Notnull Publication) Consisting of more than 5000 pages in 10 volumes following books comprising Articles, Reports Commentaries, Interviews etc. published from time to time during 1977-2016:(i) Bihar : Sapna Aur Sach, 2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (ii) Jharkhand : Sampanna Dharati-Udas Basant, 2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (iii) Jharkhand: Chunauti Bhi-Awsar Bhi, 2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (iv) Rashtriya Charitra ka Aaina,2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (v) Patan Ki Hod, 2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (vi) Bhavishya Ka Bharat, 2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (vii) Sarokar Aur Samvad,2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (viii) Atit Ke Panne,2024, Prakashan Sansthan, (ix) Urja Ke Utsa,2024, Prakashan Sansthan and (x) Safar Ke Shesh, 2024, Prakashan Sansthan In English: Chandrashekhar: The last Icon of Ideological Politics, 2019, Rupa Publications Edited books:(i) Jharkhand: Disum Muktigatha aur Srijanke Sapne, 2002, Rajkamal Prakashan, (ii) Johar Jharkhand, 2002, Rajkamal Prakashan, (iii) Jharkhand: Sushasan Ab bhi Sambhavna Hai, 2009, Prabhat Prakashan, (iv) Santal Hool-Adivasi Pratirodh Sanskriti, 2009, Prakashan Sansthan, (v) Jharkhand Asmitake Aayam, 2011, Prakashan Sansthan, (vi) Biharnama, 2011, Prakashan Sansthan, (vii) Bihar: Raste ki Talash, 2011, Prakashan Sansthan and (viii) Bihar: Asmita Ke Aayam, 2011, Prakashan Sansthan Edited Books, related to Shri Chandrashekharji (former Prime Minister of India):(i) Chandrashekhar ke Vichar, 2002, Rajkamal Prakashan, (ii) Chandrashekhar Samvad (ek) : Uthal-Puthal aur Dhruvikaran ke Beech, 2002, Rajkamal Prakashan, (iii) Chandrashekhar Samvad (do): Rachnatmak Bechaini Mein, 2002, Rajkamal Prakashan, (iv) Chandrashekhar Samvad (teen) – Ek Dusre Shikhar se, 2002, Rajkamal Prakashan, (v) Chandrashekhar ke Bare Mein, 2002 Rajkamal Prakashan and (vi) Meri Jail Diary (two volumes), 2002, Rajkamal Prakashan
social_activities: Awards: First Madhav Rao Sapre Award in August 2008 at Bhopal (Madhya Pradesh) for his dedicated contribution in the field of journalism; Exchange 4 Media honoured as Media Maharathi (ranked Top 3 journalist of country amongst top 50 journalists of country); was honoured by Acharya Mahaveer Prasad Dwivedi Patrakarita Samman (1996, Akhil Bharatiya Patrakarita Parishad, Kolkata); was honoured for his outstanding contribution to Hindi during the 9th World Hindi Conference held at Johannesburg (South Africa) in September, 2012 Journalistic accomplishments: Started Journalism (as Sub-Editor) with Dharamyug (prestigious Hindi magazine), TOI Group, Mumbai, 1977-81; Assistant Editor, Ravivar (Hindi weekly), ABP Group, Kolkata, 1985-89; Chief Editor, Prabhat Khabar, Hindi daily, Ranchi, 1989 - June 1990 and June 1991- 30 June 2016; served on several Boards, Commissions and Committees of Government of India; Consulting Editor, Vidura (Hindi), a prestigious magazine of Press Institute of India; active participation in many social programmes such as Right to Information Campaign (Jharkhand-Bihar), Literacy Campaign (Asian Development Research Institute (ADRI), (Bihar-Jharkhand), liquor ban (mass campaign with women’s group in rural areas of Jharkhand), Bharat Jodo Abhiyan with Baba Amte, Bharatyatra with Shri Chandrashekhar (former Prime Minister) and Voter Awareness Campaign; as an Editor, organizing lecture series ‘Bharat Kidhar’ for public awareness in different cities of Jharkhand-Bihar; promoted sports and cultural activities in Bihar and Jharkhand
hobbies: Participated in organizing tournaments at village level for the development of sports and sportspersons in rural areas; participated in facilitation programmes of sportspersons
countries_visited: As Journalist: U.S.A. on the invitation of USIS; travelled to U.K., Russia, China, Mexico, Brazil, Ethiopia, Tanzania, Mauritius, Japan, Malaysia, Vietnam and Italy, as a member of the Media delegation with the then Prime Minister; attended the World Hindi Conferences held in London (U.K.), 1999, Suriname, 2003, New York (U.S.A.), 2007 and Johannesburg (South Africa), 2012; attended WAN (World Association of Newspapers) meetings in Moscow (Russia), Gutenberg and Cape Town (South Africa); U.K., to attend the International Growth Week Conference Parliamentary visits: Switzerland, to attend 131st (2014), 139th (2018), 148th (2024) and 149th (2024) Assembly of Inter Parliamentary Union; New York (U.S.A.), to attend UN 72nd Meet in 2017; Japan, as leader of Goodwill Delegation of Rajya Sabha in 2019; Qatar, to attend 140th Assembly of Inter Parliamentary Union in 2019; Maldives, to attend 4th South Asian Speakers Meet in 2019; Kazakhstan, to attend Eurasian Countries' Parliament Meet in 2019; Canada, to attend Speakers and Presiding Officers Conference in 2020; Vienna (Austria), to attend 5th World Conference of Speakers of Parliaments and First Global Parliamentary Summit on Counter-Terrorism in 2021; Rome (Italy), to attend 7th G20 Speaker’s Summitt (P20) in 2021; Jakarta (Indonesia), to attend 8th G20 Speakers’ Summit in 2022; Kigali (Rwanda), to attend 145th Assembly of IPU in 2022; Canberra (Australia), to attend 26th Conference of the Speakers and Presiding Officers of the Commonwealth (CSPOC) in 2023; South Africa, to attend 9th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in 2023; Kampala (Uganda), to attend 27th Conference of the Speakers and Presiding Officers of the Commonwealth (CSPOC) in 2024; Hungary, as leader of Indian Parliamentary Delegation in 2024; St. Petersburg (Russia), to attend 10th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in 2024; Brasilia (Brazil), to attend the 10th P20 Parliamentary Speakers’ Summit in 2024; Tashkent (Uzbekistan) to attend 150th IPU Assembly; Brasilia (Brazil), to attend the 11th BRICS Parliamentary Forum in 2025; Cape Town (South Africa), to attend 11th G20 Parliamentary Speakers’ Summit (P20) in 2025 and Bridgetown (Barbados), to attend 68th Commonwealth Parliamentary Conference (CPC) in 2025, Bhutan, to lead Indian Parliamentary Delegation to Thimphu (Bhutan), in May, 2026
other_information: Official Language Officer, Bank of India, Hyderabad and Patna, 1981-84; Additional Information Advisor (in the rank of Joint Secretary, Government of India) to the Prime Minister, Shri Chandrasekhar, 1990-91
